# On The Spot Repair Service & Tires

> 24/7 mobile truck and tire repair based in Unadilla, GA, serving the I-75 corridor and Middle/South Georgia. Full-service mechanic for semi trucks, trailers, refrigerated reefers, RVs, buses, and passenger cars, plus emergency roadside assistance and computer diagnostics.

## Business Facts
- Name: On The Spot Repair Service & Tires (On The Spot Repair Services & Tires, Inc.)

- Hours: Shop walk-in Mon-Sat 8am-5pm; 24/7 emergency roadside and tire service every day
- Google rating: 4.3 stars across 29 reviews
- Website: https://www.onthespotrepairservicestires.com

## Services
- Emergency roadside assistance (24/7)
- Semi truck, trailer, and refrigerated reefer repair
- Commercial and passenger tire repair, mounting, and balancing
- Diesel engine diagnostics and repair
- Brake service and DOT inspections
- Fleet maintenance programs with account billing
- RV and bus repair
- Jump-starts, battery replacement, lockouts, and fuel delivery
